# LiteShade

A little less green.

Colour adjustments, GPose filters, optional depth of field and vignette.
Uses the game's own effects and leaves the UI alone.

Pick a preset or make your own. Share profiles and switch them automatically by zone, weather, Eorzea time and more.

variant.author: Zeffuro
variant.changelog:
# 1.0.1.0
- Reworked the config and preset browser.
- Added profile folders and favourites.
- Added GPose filter search, favourites and arrows.
- Added shadow/highlight tint, black/white levels and an RGB channel mixer.
- Added separate resets, temporary bypass and pause options for each effect.
- Added undo/redo.
- Added copying selected effects from another profile.
- Added selective pack import and renaming profiles during import.
- Added pack details and updating previously imported packs.
- Added undoing imports and file import/export.
- Added condition search, filters and bulk enable/disable.

variant.changelog:
# 1.0.2.0
- Added midtone tint, shadow/highlight brightness and grading balance/blending.
- Added a midtones slider and an RGB curve editor.
- Added combat pause options and fades when pausing colours.
- Added reset buttons for individual sliders.
- Added advanced controls and options to hide effects in the editor.
